variants.headline: Looking back: building finished and handed over
variants.sub: The project {project} has been completed and handed over by {builder}.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The builder {builder} had finished and handed over {project}.

Completion and handover are delivery milestones, while opening is an operating milestone. Managers should keep those stages separate in assessing a project. A finished building warrants recognition without a forecast of output, demand or financial return that cannot be established merely from the fact of construction being complete.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The contribution of {target} merits consideration through the completed handover. This account distinguishes delivery from the opening that follows, and does not treat completion as an established record of later operating results.
